test_cases.description: Validate food data. 'taskId' and 'templateId' must be non-empty strings. 'data' must be an object. Inside 'data', 'images' must be a list of at least one non-empty string (URL/path), and 'food_description' must be a non-empty string. The validation function should check all conditions and report all reasons for failure if the data is invalid, joining them into a single reason string.

Validate NFT data. 'taskId' and 'templateId' must be non-empty strings. 'data' must be an object. Inside 'data', 'nft_image' (URL/path) and 'nft_description' must be non-empty strings. The validation function should check all conditions and report all reasons for failure if the data is invalid, joining them into a single reason string.

Validate outfit data. 'taskId' and 'templateId' must be non-empty strings. 'data' must be an object. Inside 'data', 'top_image', 'bottom_image', and 'full_outfit_image' (URLs/paths) must be non-empty strings. The validation function should check all conditions and report all reasons for failure if the data is invalid, joining them into a single reason string.

Validate speech data. 'taskId' and 'templateId' must be non-empty strings. 'data' must be an object. Inside 'data', 'language' must be a non-empty string (e.g., 'en-US'), 'speech_audio' (URL/path) must be a non-empty string, and 'speech_text' must be a non-empty string. The validation function should check all conditions and report all reasons for failure if the data is invalid, joining them into a single reason string.
